text: I feel a quiet curiosity awakening within me as I walk these bright, modern halls. There is a sense of order and possibility, as if this space exists to cultivate thought and inquiry. Stepping into the exhibit with bold graphics and illuminated screens, I am struck by the interplay of design and intellect—an invitation to contemplate the evolution of knowledge. I feel alert, slightly out of place but open to whatever insights this blend of technology and creativity may reveal.
